text:
raj (sre): starting triage — noticed intermittent 5xx + TLS handshake failures for cross-region traffic (us-west -> eu-west) around 09:45 UTC. opening thread for follow-ups.

infra-bot: alert: high_5xx_rate detected on route /api/v1/generate · 09:46 UTC · avg_latency=420ms p95=980ms · incident_id=inc-20260315-01

simon (eng-runtime): saw connection resets from downstream proxies, sample attached. likely mid-handshake tear.

raj (sre): quick context — similar symptom to older SNI/mismatch patterns but payload and path look different. want focused data collection first.

maria (networking): hypothesis: egress NAT path asymmetry -> handshake sometimes lands on LB with differing cert set. I'll run pcaps on egress gateways.

simon (eng-runtime): can someone repro from a repro pod? command to run:
```
curl -v --resolve api.redwood.internal:443:10.0.1.2 https://api.redwood.internal/health
```

raj (sre): pasted logs from proxy span: 
```
[09:45:12] TLS handshake failed: alert handshake_failure (40) from 10.2.3.4
[09:45:12] SNI: api.redwood.internal, cert CN: lb-eu-west-2
tcp_reset_count: 27 -> 83 in 2m
```

olivia (product): how many customers impacted? any high-touch tenants?

raj (sre): limited but visible impact for ~3 enterprise tenants on dedicated pools — increased retries and timeouts. not a global outage but visible SLA blowups for those tenants.

maria (networking): action A1: start 30m pcap on egress-gw-us-west-2 (port 443) to capture handshake failures and SNI exchanges. owner: maria (networking). ETA: 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC.

simon (eng-runtime): action A2 (mitigation): increase transient backoff for cross-region retries from 250ms -> 500ms for 24h to reduce hammering failed handshakes. owner: simon (eng-runtime). ETA: 2026-03-16 12:00 UTC. will roll via config service.

olivia (product): action A3: prepare customer comms + support playbook for impacted tenants. owner: olivia (product). ETA: 2026-03-16 18:00 UTC.

raj (sre): action A4: instrument additional TLS debug telemetry for handshake failures (capture SNI, cert CN, route_id, peer ASN). owner: raj (sre). ETA: 2026-03-17 09:00 UTC.

eng-oncall: runbook linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/network-tls-sni (bookmark it for troubleshooting).

maria (networking): initial pcap notes: seeing SYN -> RST from 10.10.5.1 (egress-nat) coincident with routing table updates; ~0.7% of handshakes show ALPN mismatch. saving pcap to /tmp/pcap-egr-0315.pcap.

simon (eng-runtime): quick config mitigation deployed: increased retry backoff and enabled sticky-conn for same-client sessions to reduce mid-handshake region handoffs. rolling config: 20% -> 100% over 30m. will monitor error trend.

raj (sre): created metric tls_handshake_failures.crossregion and dashboard. set alert threshold to 10/min.

olivia (product): thanks — please capture a short postmortem once RCA is clearer, include customer impact table.

maria (networking): follow-up A5: open cloud provider ticket for observed routing table churn and ask for AS-path trace for NAT hops. owner: maria (networking) + cloud-eng. ETA: 2026-03-20 00:00 UTC.

simon (eng-runtime): observed secondary effect: KV cache misses spike during bursts -> slightly longer connection setup time which can amplify race windows for handshakes. adding eval to Optimize team.

raj (sre): immediate alert suppressed, mitigation in place. reconvene for sync 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC to review pcap + telemetry. if you find any new evidence ping @raj (sre) and drop artifacts here. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: incident state -> mitigated (2026-03-15 11:12 UTC)

maria (networking): uploaded capture and narrowed to 09:44:38 - 09:51:12 UTC window to reduce noise. sharing folder link in thread.

simon (eng-runtime): will follow up with config rollout IDs and PR link once the 100% roll completes.

raj (sre): noted owners & ETAs above. capturing this thread as the authoritative follow-up log for the incident.

olivia (product): :white_check_mark:

cloud-eng: added to ticket for provider escalation — will share provider case ID in thread when available.
